hookTextEnter.condition: Hook text enter or lower-third slide peak frame
hookTextEnter.acousticPrompt: Deep warm sub-bass thump at 60Hz paired with a tight, short silk air whoosh, 0.3 seconds, dry studio mix

keywordReveal.condition: Playfair Display keyword entry, selector box lock, or arrow draw peak frame
keywordReveal.acousticPrompt: Crisp tactile mechanical camera shutter click and subtle muted wooden pop, 0.15 seconds, no echo

moleculePop.condition: Molecule pop or circle appear peak frame
moleculePop.acousticPrompt: Soft organic water-droplet marimba pop with warm low-mid body, 0.2 seconds, dry

graphStepVertex.condition: stair-step vertex hit or graph rise buildup
graphStepVertex.acousticPrompt: Fast ascending digital ratchet ticks accelerating smoothly over 0.8 seconds, clean transient

cameraSlideWhoosh.condition: camera slide-in or stepped reveal peak frame
cameraSlideWhoosh.acousticPrompt: Deep warm sub-bass thump at 60Hz paired with a tight, short silk air whoosh, 0.3 seconds, dry studio mix

shutterImpact.condition: shutter breakthrough or major visual impact
shutterImpact.acousticPrompt: Punchy cinematic low-end impact hit with crisp glass/ceramic crackle transient, tight decay

v2aFoley.negativePrompt: music, melody, singing, speech, talking, crowd chatter, heavy reverb
